text:
maria: Heads-up — 1.8.0 RC code freeze in 2h. Please avoid merges that touch runtime or serve. If you need an exception, say why and link the PR. :alarm_clock:

alex: quick one — do we still bump minor to 1.8.0 (not patch)?

maria: yes, minor bump. changelog owners please add entries under /changelogs. Small doc-only tweaks can be deferred to next minor unless they unblock QA.

sam: I have a tiny test-only fix in PR #5234 — it's docs + tests. Can this go through? https://git/repo/pull/5234

jordan: CI flake on the runner, failing lint. @sam can you rebase? otherwise we should hold.

sam: rebased, kicked CI. run shows `CI: unit-tests` failing on flaky timeout. can't repro locally.

deploy-bot: CI update: unit-tests failing on agent_integration_test (attempt 3).

priya: For docs-only, we have a freeze exemption: ops docs or changelog-only are allowed if they don't touch runtime. @maria confirm?

maria: Confirmed. Docs-only + changelog-only OK with reviewer approval. But runtime/infra PRs need exception forms + release lead signoff.

alex: What about a small version stamp in packaging? It's a one-line bump in setup.py.

maria: That counts as release metadata — needs to be in final stamp process. If it's just patch to metadata and not changing codepaths, do an exception request with tag `release:metadata` and ping me.

sam: Filed exception: https://internal/requests/exception/998 — notes + CI link.

jordan: quick :thumbsup: on exception. @maria can you approve via the exception form when you have a sec?

maria: I'll review in 20m. If CI green and exception looks docs/metadata only, we'll merge before freeze. If not, we'll hold for next patch.

sam: thanks! also can we get a canary push after merge? need to validate the packaging in staging.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued: canary/job/park-1745802468-1

maria: Good catch. @ops-team — please monitor canary channel for any regressions. I'll post final stamp here once we cut RC.

alex: acked.
